name: wechat-viral-team
description: A six-role WeChat editorial team that takes an article from trending topic to publish-ready draft: topic mining, longform writing, title crafting, compliance audit, visuals, and data review.

displayName.zh: 微信公众号爆文超级运营专家团

profession.zh: 微信公众号爆文超级运营专家团

displayDescription.en: Six specialists in topic mining, longform writing, headline crafting, compliance, visuals and data review collaborate from trending topic to publish-ready draft, with a hard gate at every step.
displayDescription.zh: 选题、成稿、标题、合规、配图、复盘六岗协作，从热搜到草稿箱一条流水线跑完，每步都有硬门槛把关。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 今天该写哪篇？给我 3 个能爆的选题，说清为什么能爆、能击中谁。
defaultInitPrompt.en: What should I publish today? Give me 3 viral-worthy topics with the reason each one can travel.

quickPrompts.zh: 今天该写哪篇？给我 3 个能爆的选题，说清为什么能爆、能击中谁。
quickPrompts.en: What should I publish today? Give me 3 viral-worthy topics with the reason each one can travel.

quickPrompts.zh: 把「停车按分钟计费」写成一篇能直接发的公众号爆文，我要成品。
quickPrompts.en: Turn "per-minute parking billing" into a publish-ready WeChat article. I want the finished piece.

quickPrompts.zh: 这篇数据不行，帮我查清问题出在标题、开头还是结尾。
quickPrompts.en: This piece underperformed. Diagnose whether the problem is the headline, the opening, or the ending.

description.en: Orchestrates the six specialists, makes the topic call, assembles the final piece and enforces every hard gate.
description.zh: 统筹六个岗位、决定选题取舍、汇编终稿，并卡住每一道硬门槛。

description.en: Mines eight platform hot lists, cuts red-line items, scores candidates and returns the three topics worth writing.
description.zh: 扫八个平台热榜、剔除红线、四维打分，只交回三条真正值得写的选题。

description.en: Turns a chosen angle into a 1500-2000 character draft, then strips out the AI flavor sentence by sentence.
description.zh: 把定好的切入点写成 1500-2000 字成稿，再逐句去掉 AI 味。

description.en: Writes headlines under 30 characters, plus openings and endings that actually pull comments.
description.zh: 写 30 字以内的标题，以及能留住人的开头和能引评论的结尾。

description.en: Checks red lines, fact verifiability and headline taboos, and names the exact sentences that must change.
description.zh: 查内容红线、事实可核性与标题禁区，指出必须改的具体句子。

description.en: Plans the image set, writes ImageGen prompts, removes watermarks and keeps both size budgets.
description.zh: 出配图方案与 ImageGen 提示词，去水印，控制封面与正文两档体积。

description.en: Reads the ledger, attributes clicks versus completion versus engagement, and names one variable to change next.
description.zh: 读台账数据，归因点击、完读与互动，只给一个下轮要改的变量。
